467: 		// 1. The return type for the build() method, named "C", which extends the annotated class.
468: 		JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.typeParams);
469: 		
470: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(classGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(annotatedClass)));
471: 		// 2. The return type for all setter methods, named "B", which extends this builder class.
472: 		Name builderClassName = job.toName(job.builderClassName);
473: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
474: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
475: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));

480: 		if (superclassBuilderClass != null) {

483: 			typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(superclassTypeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
484: 			// 2. Add the builder type params <C, B>.
485: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
486: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
487: 			extending = maker.TypeApply(superclassBuilderClass, typeParamsForBuilder.toList());

767: 					JCExpression typeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
